verdict.rationale: monday.com's first-party docs describe native agents you can talk to like teammates: you message them in updates, assign them items, and @mention them to kick off work, with replies, statuses and follow-ups included (monday-docs-11, monday-docs-19, monday-docs-15). You can also create custom agents by describing a workflow in plain words, and they handle tasks like scheduled reports, call summaries and risk spotting (monday-docs-13, monday-docs-14, monday-docs-21, monday-docs-23, monday-docs-39). Admins can scope each agent's board access and audit its actions (monday-docs-10). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed, and in-depth docs beyond marketing-level descriptions of the agent's behavior and limits.
